balanceBaseline: v8.5.0 native Dart gameplay; v8.5.2 is cosmetic-only
notes: Observed clear rates are competent-policy simulation proxies, not measured human first-attempt rates.
Every blocked deck is an explicit prevalidated deck order; production must never cut a fresh random half-deck.
Level Jokers are temporary and must not mutate account unlock ownership.

levels.name: First Pair
levels.description: Score one Pair.
levels.hint: Keep two cards of the same rank.

levels.name: Pair Practice
levels.description: Score two Pairs before your plays run out.
levels.hint: Keep duplicate ranks and discard isolated cards.

levels.name: Two at Once
levels.description: Score one Two Pair.
levels.hint: Build two separate pairs in the same play.

levels.name: Double Two
levels.description: Score two Two Pairs.
levels.hint: Do not spend both pairs unless the remaining hand can rebuild.

levels.name: Triple Two
levels.description: Score three Two Pairs in five plays.
levels.hint: Discard singletons; preserve every pair.

levels.name: Three Together
levels.description: Score one Three of a Kind.
levels.hint: Keep a pair and draw for the third card.

levels.name: Run It
levels.description: Score one Straight.
levels.hint: Keep connected ranks; Ace can be high or low.

levels.name: Same Suit
levels.description: Score one Flush.
levels.hint: Keep the suit with the most cards.

levels.name: Full House
levels.description: Score one Full House.
levels.hint: Build a three-card rank and a separate pair.

levels.name: First Score Test
levels.description: Reach the score target using at least two different hand types.
levels.hint: Play made hands instead of five-card High Cards.

levels.name: Pair Chain
levels.description: Score three Pairs in four plays.
levels.hint: Preserve duplicate ranks between plays.

levels.name: Two Pair Chain
levels.description: Score two Two Pairs in four plays.
levels.hint: Use discards before spending a fragile Two Pair.

levels.name: Mixed Set
levels.description: Score a Pair, Two Pair and Three of a Kind.
levels.hint: Plan the order so one rank can grow from a pair into trips.

levels.name: Straight Practice
levels.description: Score two Straights.
levels.hint: Keep overlapping connected ranks after the first Straight.

levels.name: Flush Practice
levels.description: Score two Flushes.
levels.hint: Commit to the suit with the deepest remaining deck.

levels.name: House Party
levels.description: Score one Full House and one Pair.
levels.hint: Bank the Pair only when the Full House route remains intact.

levels.name: Four Strong
levels.description: Score Four of a Kind.
levels.hint: Hold three matching cards and use discards aggressively.

levels.name: Variety Pack
levels.description: Score four different hand types.
levels.hint: Do not repeat an easy hand when a new type is available.

levels.name: No Waste
levels.description: Reach the score target without playing High Card.
levels.hint: Discard weak hands instead of scoring them.

levels.name: Basics Final
levels.description: Reach the target with three hand types, including a Straight, Flush or better.
levels.hint: Secure the premium hand before using the remaining plays for variety.

levels.name: No High Cards
levels.description: High Card scores zero. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Discard until you can make at least a Pair.

levels.name: Pairs Only
levels.description: Only Pair and Two Pair score. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Kickers do not score; protect duplicate ranks.
visibleModifiers: Only Pair and Two Pair score

levels.name: Red Heat
levels.description: Red cards give 1.5× rank; black cards give 0.5×. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Prefer Hearts and Diamonds when two hands are otherwise equal.

levels.name: Blackout
levels.description: Black cards give 1.5× rank; red cards give 0.5×. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Prefer Spades and Clubs.

levels.name: Face Off
levels.description: Jacks, Queens and Kings contribute zero rank. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Face cards can still form a hand, but their rank points disappear.

levels.name: Ace Lock
levels.description: All Aces are removed. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Build around connected middle ranks instead of Ace-high routes.

levels.name: Repeat Tax
levels.description: Each repeat of a hand type loses 40% score. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Change hand type before the repeat penalty compounds.

levels.name: Costly Discards
levels.description: Every discard raises the target. Clear it efficiently.
levels.hint: A discard is worthwhile only when the stronger draw covers its tax.

levels.name: Final Hand
levels.description: Early plays score 25% less; the fifth play scores double.
levels.hint: Save the best visible route for the double-score final play.

levels.name: Modifier Checkpoint
levels.description: Face cards score no rank and repeats lose 40%. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Use varied number-card hands.

levels.name: One of Each
levels.description: A repeated hand type scores zero. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Treat each hand type as a one-use resource.

levels.name: In Order
levels.description: Play Pair, Two Pair and Straight in that order.
levels.hint: Do not play the Straight early even when it is visible.

levels.name: Even Lock
levels.description: Ranks 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 are removed. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Use duplicate odd ranks and face-card runs.

levels.name: Odd Lock
levels.description: Ranks 3, 5, 7 and 9 are removed. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Even ranks remain dense enough for pairs and selected Straights.

levels.name: Suit Shift
levels.description: One visible suit contributes zero rank each play. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Check the current disabled suit before committing a hand.
visibleModifiers: Suit disabled in visible S/H/D/C rotation

levels.name: Shrinking Discards
levels.description: After every scoring play, one unused discard disappears.
levels.hint: Use needed discards early; they do not remain available.
visibleModifiers: Lose one unused discard after each scored hand

levels.name: Four Hands
levels.description: Reach the target with four plays and three discards.
levels.hint: Every scoring play must contribute.

levels.name: Two Discards
levels.description: Reach the target with only two discards.
levels.hint: Keep flexible shapes rather than chasing one unlikely hand.

levels.name: Rising Pressure
levels.description: Hit a cumulative checkpoint after each of the first four plays.
levels.hint: A weak first play can make every later checkpoint impossible.

levels.name: Modifier Final
levels.description: Face cards give no rank, hand types cannot repeat, and the target is high.
levels.hint: Plan four different number-card hands before spending a play.

levels.name: Quarter Blocked
levels.description: 25% of the deck is removed. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Inspect what remains before choosing a route.

levels.name: Pairs Through It
levels.description: 25% blocked. Score two Pairs.
levels.hint: Choose ranks that still have multiple copies available.

levels.name: Double Pair
levels.description: 25% blocked. Score two Two Pairs.
levels.hint: The deck inspector shows which pair routes still exist.

levels.name: Broken Run
levels.description: 33% blocked. Score a Straight.
levels.hint: Find a five-rank corridor that survived the block.

levels.name: Thin Suit
levels.description: 33% blocked. Score a Flush.
levels.hint: Count the remaining cards in each suit first.

levels.name: Forty Down
levels.description: 40% blocked. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Adapt to the strongest duplicate or suit concentration.

levels.name: Adapt
levels.description: 40% blocked. Score three different hand types and reach the target.
levels.hint: Use the surviving deck shape rather than forcing one archetype.

levels.name: Half Deck
levels.description: 50% blocked. Reach the target.
levels.hint: The smaller deck makes some ranks dense and others absent.

levels.name: Find a Route
levels.description: 50% blocked. Score a Straight or Flush and reach the target.
levels.hint: Compare the surviving rank corridor with the surviving suits.

levels.name: Half-Deck Final
levels.description: 50% blocked. Reach the chapter target in five plays.
levels.hint: Commit early to the strongest route visible in the deck matrix.

levels.name: Half and No High
levels.description: 50% blocked and High Card scores zero.
levels.hint: Use discards to avoid wasting a play on zero.

levels.name: Half and Tight
levels.description: 50% blocked with only three discards.
levels.hint: Preserve flexible pairs and four-card suit groups.

levels.name: Half and Faceless
levels.description: 50% blocked and face cards give no rank.
levels.hint: Face cards may complete a hand but should not drive the score plan.

levels.name: Red Rescue
levels.description: 50% blocked; only red cards contribute rank.
levels.hint: Hearts and Diamonds carry the rank score.

levels.name: Black Rescue
levels.description: 50% blocked; only black cards contribute rank.
levels.hint: Spades and Clubs carry the rank score.

levels.name: Half Variety
levels.description: 50% blocked and hand types cannot repeat.
levels.hint: Map four surviving hand types before the first play.

levels.name: Half Sequence
levels.description: 50% blocked. Play Pair, Two Pair and Straight in order.
levels.hint: The required order matters more than the first visible score.

levels.name: Half Pressure
levels.description: 50% blocked. Hit four cumulative score checkpoints.
levels.hint: Do not fall behind the first checkpoint.

levels.name: Shifting Suit
levels.description: 50% blocked and one suit is disabled each play.
levels.hint: Re-evaluate the best suit every play.
visibleModifiers: Suit disabled in visible S/H/D/C rotation

levels.name: Restricted Final
levels.description: 50% blocked, face cards give no rank and repeats decay.
levels.hint: Use varied number-card hands from the surviving deck.

levels.name: Copper Chip
levels.description: Use the fixed Copper Chip to reach the target.
levels.hint: Flat +Mult improves every hand, so play made hands consistently.

levels.name: Pair Polisher
levels.description: Use the fixed Pair Polisher to reach the target.
levels.hint: Pair-or-better activates ×1.4; High Card does not.

levels.name: Chips Times Mult
levels.description: Combine Copper Chip and Pair Polisher.
levels.hint: Additive Mult becomes stronger when multiplied by Pair Polisher.

levels.name: Royal Engine
levels.description: Use Royal Retainer and Royal Scam to score face-card hands.
levels.hint: J, Q and K receive extra rank and then score twice.

levels.name: Glass Cannon
levels.description: Use Glass Joystick with one fewer discard.
levels.hint: The fixed ×3 makes strong hand bases far more valuable.

levels.name: Pair Build
levels.description: Use Pair Polisher, Metronome and Twin Flame. Score three Pair-or-better hands and reach the target.
levels.hint: Repeating a made hand activates Double Down and grows Pair Trainer.

levels.name: Straight Build
levels.description: Use Straight Wire, Gap Filler and Full Table. Score a Straight and reach the target.
levels.hint: Shortcut enables three-card Straights; Straight Wire multiplies them.

levels.name: Flush Build
levels.description: Use Flush Fund, Pocket Flush and Suit Swap. Score a Flush and reach the target.
levels.hint: Pocket Flush reduces the requirement to four same-suit cards.

levels.name: Choose Three
levels.description: Choose three Jokers from six and reach the target.
levels.hint: Combine a broad multiplier with a condition you can trigger often.

levels.name: Joker Checkpoint
levels.description: Choose three Jokers from five and clear the target.
levels.hint: Final-play effects can stack, but the earlier plays still need to set up the clear.

levels.name: Pair Architect
levels.description: Choose three Jokers; score four Pair-or-better hands and reach the target.
levels.hint: The intended engine rewards repeated made hands.

levels.name: Straight Architect
levels.description: Choose three Jokers; score two Straights and reach the target.
levels.hint: Shortcut improves consistency; Straight Wire supplies the payoff.

levels.name: Flush Architect
levels.description: Choose three Jokers; score two Flushes and reach the target.
levels.hint: Use an enabler, a Flush payoff and a colour payoff.

levels.name: Rank Architect
levels.description: Choose three Jokers; score two Three-of-a-Kind-or-better hands.
levels.hint: Choose rank bonuses that overlap with the ranks you intend to collect.

levels.name: Dead Slot
levels.description: Dividend occupies one non-scoring slot. Choose two scoring Jokers and clear the target.
levels.hint: Treat Dividend as a dead scoring slot and make the other two Jokers cover both consistency and burst.

levels.name: Rising Power
levels.description: Danger Music grows after each played hand. Reach the target.
levels.hint: Later hands receive much larger ×Mult; preserve a strong final route.

levels.name: Joker Blackout
levels.description: Choose three Jokers; one selected Joker is disabled each play.
levels.hint: Choose effects that remain useful even when one piece goes dark.
visibleModifiers: One chosen Joker disabled each play

levels.name: Quarter Block Build
levels.description: 25% blocked. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Inspect the layout before choosing Straight or Flush support.

levels.name: Half Block Build
levels.description: 50% blocked. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Prefer flexible power unless the blocked layout clearly supports a specialist.

levels.name: Build Final
levels.description: Choose three of six Jokers; score the target in four plays and three discards.
levels.hint: Build around a reliable base and one late-hand finisher.

levels.name: Double Trouble
levels.description: Two visible modifiers are active. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Choose broad Jokers and vary your made hands.

levels.name: No Repeat Build
levels.description: Hand types cannot repeat. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Specialist hand Jokers are risky when each hand type can score only once.

levels.name: Black Build
levels.description: Red cards contribute zero rank. Choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Ink Trade directly strengthens the live black cards.

levels.name: Red Build
levels.description: Black cards contribute zero rank. Choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Suit Presser turns Hearts into the strongest red route.

levels.name: Expensive Discards
levels.description: Each discard adds a large amount to the target.
levels.hint: Only discard when the likely score gain exceeds the added target.

levels.name: Scorched Ranks
levels.description: After a scoring hand, every remaining card sharing a played rank is burned. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Do not burn useful duplicate ranks on weak hands.
visibleModifiers: Every played rank burns from the remaining deck

levels.name: Combo Ladder
levels.description: Play Pair, Two Pair, Three of a Kind and Straight in order.
levels.hint: The order is absolute; preserve cards needed by later rungs.

levels.name: Four Styles
levels.description: Score four different hand types and reach the target.
levels.hint: Choose broad power rather than a single-hand specialist.

levels.name: Half-Deck Blackout
levels.description: 50% blocked and one chosen Joker is disabled each play.
levels.hint: The best build has redundancy and matches the surviving deck.
visibleModifiers: One chosen Joker disabled each play

levels.name: Expert Final
levels.description: Three visible modifiers are active. Choose three of six Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Use broad multipliers and plan varied number-card hands.
visibleModifiers: One chosen Joker disabled each play

levels.name: Open Build
levels.description: Choose three of six Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: The strongest raw trio is not always the most consistent over five plays.

levels.name: Half-Deck Power
levels.description: 50% blocked. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Let the blocked layout decide whether an enabler is worth a slot.

levels.name: Half-Deck Variety
levels.description: 50% blocked, no repeated hand types, choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Broad power is safer than a specialist in a no-repeat level.

levels.name: Minimal Discards
levels.description: Only two discards. Choose three Jokers and reach the target.
levels.hint: Choose consistency and accept strong visible hands rather than chasing perfection.

levels.name: Faceless Build
levels.description: Jacks, Queens and Kings are removed. Choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Low-rank bonuses become more reliable in the faceless deck.

levels.name: Low-Card Lock
levels.description: Ranks 2–6 are removed. Choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Face-card and Ace engines fit the surviving high-rank deck.

levels.name: Decay
levels.description: Every repeat loses another 35% of its value.
levels.hint: Use a different hand before a repeated type collapses in value.

levels.name: Fading Jokers
levels.description: After every scoring hand, one Joker becomes permanently disabled.
levels.hint: Put early power to work before the build disappears.
visibleModifiers: One Joker permanently fades after each play

levels.name: The Wall
levels.description: 50% blocked, no repeats and discards raise the target. Choose three Jokers.
levels.hint: Avoid unnecessary discards and extract four different hands from the layout.

levels.name: Master Level
levels.description: 50% blocked. Choose three of six Jokers, survive three visible modifiers, use at least three hand types and clear the final target.
levels.hint: Read the layout, choose a redundant build and preserve a premium final hand.
visibleModifiers: Suit disabled in visible S/H/D/C rotation
